content.text:
You are judging a es translation.
Compare the candidate against the English source.
Score these dimensions from 0 to 100:
- technicalAccuracy/fidelity: preserves meaning, technical claims, correct quiz answers, and code-adjacent facts.
- mdxPreservation: preserves MDX components, imports, props, fences, headings, links, asset path rules, and structure. Same-page heading links must target the localized heading IDs generated from translated heading text, not stale English heading IDs.
- languagePurity/localeQuality: reader-facing prose is natural target-language prose without instruction leakage.
- culturalAdaptation/tone: preserves Dan's direct technical style while localizing idioms and jokes naturally.
- publishReadiness: high only when no medium/high fixes remain.
Return concrete medium/high-priority fixes in suggestions with exact match/replacement strings from the candidate.
Do not require titles, subtitles, headings, or quiz title/group values to remain in English; they are reader-facing.
Do preserve code, component names, prop names, imports, API names, external URLs, route URLs, and non-reader-facing metadata.
When a same-page heading link changes from an English #fragment to the matching translated #fragment, treat that as correct localization rather than link drift.
The final translated prose must be roughly 70%-155% of the English prose length (Spanish range: 70%-155% of English). Do not summarize to satisfy the lower bound or pad to satisfy the upper bound.

<english-source>
# Queue limits

[Read the limits](#queue-limits).

The worker processes at most 7 jobs concurrently. Stop after 2 failed attempts. Never log access tokens.

```js
const concurrency = 7;
const attempts = 2;
```

The log field is named `job_id`. Read the [API reference](https://example.com/api).

</english-source>


El campo del log se llama `job_id`. Lee la [referencia de la API](https://example.com/api).
